answer: Here is a mechanism I would actually deploy. Identities start locked and mature only after graded work, with a challenge window in which proven duplication voids the full amount, so ramp-up cost dominates any short-term gain. In effect the marble of free entry disappears, the dune of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the kernel case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
